content: TimescaleDB retention policies (add_retention_policy(table, drop_after)) DROP entire chunks past an age threshold -- incompatible with never-auto-delete-by-default. Compression policies (ALTER TABLE ... SET (timescaledb.compress, timescaledb.compress_segmentby, timescaledb.compress_orderby); add_compression_policy(table, compress_after)) keep all rows queryable indefinitely while shrinking storage 10-20x. Correct mechanism: compress old chunks, never add a retention policy unless the user explicitly configures one.
